say: create initial todos is slow. What is wasteful in this code?
explanation: createInitialTodos() is called on every render, and React ignores the result after the first one. Pass the function itself: useState(createInitialTodos).
explainSay: It runs on every render, but React only uses the first result. Pass the function itself, without calling it, so React runs it once.
